text:
jamie_sales: Hey team — AtlasPay wants a POC next week. They asked for SOC2 evidence, a pen-test letter, and staging access (SFTP or presigned). Also asking if Dedicated pricing applies for a short POC window. Anyone able to confirm what we can hand over and timing?

nina_ps: Hi Jamie — quick q: is this hosted (RIP) or do they want isolated/dedicated infra? That changes what artifacts we can share.

jamie_sales: Hosted Redwood, but they want tenant isolation for the POC (separate creds + restricted SFTP). Sales asked for an estimate on pricing delta if we provide dedicated staging for 2 weeks.

omar_sec: We can provide the SOC2 artifact bundle and a signed pen-test attestation letter. Pen-test letter can be redacted for sensitive details but needs Sec review first. I can share our standard template: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/pen-test-letter-template.pdf

ben_infra: For staging access, prefer ephemeral presigned S3 URLs or short-lived SFTP accounts (24h TTL). Long-lived SFTP creds are a no. If they insist on a VPC/dedicated node, that triggers Dedicated pricing — short bump (we can quote). Tag as POC-AtlasPay so billing flag picks it up.

nina_ps: For SOC2 bundle delivery we require an NDA/LOU for some artifacts. If legal can sign quick, we can push the zip via secure transfer. Also confirm the contact email for evidence delivery.

jamie_sales: Contact is legal@atlaspay.com and devops@atlaspay.com. They'll sign an NDA today per the buyer. ETA: can we aim to deliver SOC2 + pen-test letter + presigned staging creds in 3 business days? Also they prefer a redacted pen-test letter (no IPs).

omar_sec: 3 business days is tight but doable if Legal approves redaction. I will start Sec review now. We require a short statement in the pen-test attestation that says: "Redwood Inference performed a third-party penetration test on X date; vulnerabilities were remediated per policy." No raw vuln output.

ben_infra: I can provision ephemeral presigned URLs and create a short-lived SFTP account. Will need the exact list of allowed IPs (if they require IP allowlist) and the tag name. Default TTL: 24h, extendable if needed.

nina_ps: On pricing: if they require a Dedicated staging node even for 2 weeks, ops quotes are roughly +15% for that period (depends on GPU type). If ephemeral presigned + isolated creds is fine, no Dedicated charge. Jamie pls confirm what they want.

jamie_sales: Confirmed with AtlasPay — they accept presigned/ephemeral if we can IP-restrict and provide audit logs. They want a signed, redacted pen-test letter and SOC2 zip. I'll ask Legal to sign NDA now.

ci-bot: automated: Document created: /compliance/requests/3160012345-atlaspay-ndarequest — signature requested from legal@atlaspay.com

omar_sec: Ok I'm on Sec review. Jamie, please provide the exact redaction list (IPs, specific payloads) and I'll circulate for approval. After Sec sign-off I'll attach the signed PDF to the delivery package.

ben_infra: Working on provisioning. Tag requested: POC-AtlasPay. Send me the allowlist or I'll default to 0.0.0.0/0 with strict TTL and audit enabled (not ideal but can do if they can't provide IPs).

jamie_sales: Thanks all — I'll get the NDA over, ask AtlasPay for IPs, and update here. Target delivery: 3 business days. :thumbsup:
